text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I won.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Among the names of history's most valiant Umamusume,
Symboli Rudolf now stands alongside them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A title worthy of speaking of my ideals...
At last—I have attained it.

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!
Rudolf! Rudolf! Rudolf...

With the birth of a new Derby Umamusume,
the excitement in the venue showed no signs of cooling down.

That excitement spread to everyone
watching the race—
—She was no exception.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on conquering the Derby...!
It was a truly magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...?
Why are you laughing like that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it is nothing. It is merely that you, who are always so calm and collected,
greeted me with flushed cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The Derby truly is wonderful, isn't it?
I was able to see that smile."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please, stop teasing me. You achieved
such a monumental feat, of course I'd get emotional.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "In that case, I hope you'll give me an even more passionate welcome at the next race."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then, as expected—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, next is the Kikuka Sho.
I shall seize the next crown by any means necessary.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's take on the challenge!

text_block_list.text:
Our next target race is the Kikuka Sho as planned.
Though the Triple Crown is no longer possible,
the title of Classic Double Crown Umamusume is still invaluable.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if things continue this way,
you will only find yourself busier than ever."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even though summer's starting, media interviews will only increase,
and summer is when the Student Council—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I'm listening.
Please continue.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me for saying so, but you look
a bit exhausted."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Haha. Even I can't stay in high spirits
right after a race, you know."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Perhaps you should ease up on your student council duties a bit—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believe that matter has already been settled.
Let's talk about something more constructive instead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Just as you were about to say, the student council has important duties in the summer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You should know, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The annual summer training camp held to hone our skills.
We're also involved in running it, you see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Air Groove.
Can you get in touch with the bus company?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's a change in the number of units.
Well, and there's something else I want to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "However, I have to deal with the press waiting outside, so... let's see."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I will return to the academy in two hours.
Please proceed with the preparations for the meeting by then."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Understood completely.

Even after winning the Japan Derby,
Symboli Rudolf remained as composed as ever.
